headline: MSCI August India index review due today; Adani Green, Adani Energy Solutions, Groww tipped for inclusion after ASM hurdle cleared
gist: New, discrete catalyst not covered in prior briefs: MSCI's August 2026 India Standard Index review is due today, with the announcement scheduled after market hours and changes effective August 31. Adani Green Energy, Adani Energy Solutions and Groww have emerged as the strongest inclusion candidates after Adani Energy Solutions exited the Additional Surveillance Measure (ASM) framework -- the regulatory hurdle that previously blocked Adani names from MSCI inclusion (none of the Adani companies are currently under ASM or GSM). Adani Green is estimated to draw ~$773mn in passive inflows if included, Adani Energy Solutions ~$342mn; the overall India rebalancing could trigger ~$2.3bn in passive inflows. This follows Monday's separate news of the US court dismissing the Adani indictment (already covered in the prior day's brief) -- the MSCI decision is a fresh, distinct event with its own flow implications. Source: NiftyTrader/Kotak Institutional/Outlook Business.
